object.description: Setup M: physical Android device with a mock location app selected, fine location permission granted, distance unit kilometre, fixes injected once per second along 59.3000 N moving east. Accuracy threshold: 20 m. Steps: 1. Select Start. 2. Inject fix A and fix B with 5 m accuracy and note the distance. 3. Inject a fix 500 m further with an accuracy of 30 m. 4. Read the distance. Expected: Distance is unchanged from step 2.
